name: ralph
description: Ralph is an autonomous AI agent loop that runs AI coding tools (Amp, Claude Code, Antigravity, etc.) repeatedly until all PRD items are complete. Each iteration is a fresh instance with clean context. You can configure which agents are executed by setting the AGENT_ACCOUNTS variable and adding multiple API keys for rotation when limits are reached.

paths.name: Project Path
paths.description: Path to your project codebase directory (source code, tests, etc.) on Unraid

paths.name: PRD File
paths.description: Select the specific prd.json file on your host system to be mounted for this run (like selecting an ISO for a VM)

paths.name: Amp Config Path
paths.description: Persistence folder for Amp credentials and settings

paths.name: Claude Config Path
paths.description: Persistence folder for Claude Code credentials

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port to map for the Ralph Dashboard Web UI

variables.name: Active Accounts List
variables.description: Comma-separated list of accounts to use and rotate (e.g. claude-1,antigravity-1,claude-2)

variables.name: Max Iterations
variables.description: Maximum loop iterations to run before stopping if stories aren't completed

variables.name: Anthropic API Key 1
variables.description: Anthropic API Key for claude-1 account

variables.name: Anthropic API Key 2
variables.description: Anthropic API Key for claude-2 account

variables.name: Google API Key 1
variables.description: Google API Key for antigravity-1 account

variables.name: Google API Key 2
variables.description: Google API Key for antigravity-2 account

variables.name: Antigravity API Key 1
variables.description: Alternative key for antigravity-1 (leave blank if GOOGLE_API_KEY_1 is set)

variables.name: Antigravity API Key 2
variables.description: Alternative key for antigravity-2 (leave blank if GOOGLE_API_KEY_2 is set)

variables.name: Default AI Agent Tool
variables.description: Fallback default agent tool if AGENT_ACCOUNTS is empty (amp or claude)

variables.name: Default Anthropic Key
variables.description: Fallback default Anthropic Key if AGENT_ACCOUNTS is empty

variables.name: Default Google Key
variables.description: Fallback default Google Key if AGENT_ACCOUNTS is empty

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Any additional command-line parameters to pass to ralph.sh (e.g. --input-method file)

variables.name: Keep Container Alive
variables.description: Set to true to keep the container running after ralph completes, allowing shell inspection
